description: Following approval for the demolition of existing buildings (excluding the Toll House) and erection of 343 residential units - including 30 affordable housing units (19X4 bed houses, 1X3 bed house, 16X3 bed flats, 218X2 bed flats and 89X1 bed flats), 14 live/work/atelier units, a 140 bed hotel, various retail and A3 (restaurant/cafe/public house) units, surface and underground parking, a public square off the High Steet, creation of island park, use of former Toll House as heritage/office centre, wetland  ecological area, two bridges to the small island, harbour masters office, chandlery and boaters facilties, moorings, towpath and highway improvements, and felling of trees T2-T8 in London Borough of Hounslow TPO No. 347 - details submitted pursuant to Condition 4 (materials) of approved permissionref 00607/AS/P4 dated 20/04/2001.
